assertions.name: Grounded shot matching, owned PNG fixtures and explicit embedding test double uses app-owned SHA metadata for new runs and keeps previous matching input immutable
Grounded shot matching, owned PNG fixtures and explicit embedding test double replaces round-robin using exact-SHA descriptions, pins original annotations and never approves meaning or rights

Grounded shot matching, owned PNG fixtures and explicit embedding test double validates embedding output text identities, uses pinned vectors and does not silently downgrade configured inference failures
Grounded shot matching, owned PNG fixtures and explicit embedding test double keeps missing descriptions unknown and deduplicates identical source content
Grounded shot matching, owned PNG fixtures and explicit embedding test double rejects stale metadata, redirected basenames, duplicate hashes and impossible scene annotations
Grounded shot matching, owned PNG fixtures and explicit embedding test double skips measured unusable intervals and caps consecutive source repetition when an alternative exists
Grounded shot matching, owned PNG fixtures and explicit embedding test double probes actual video bounds before accepting an owner-declared timed scene
Durable image suggestion executor with explicit model test double validates structured output, records source/frame hashes and does not accept annotations automatically
Durable image suggestion executor with explicit model test double rejects malformed model output and preserves the original source
Durable image suggestion executor with explicit model test double requeues GPU contention instead of presenting it as completed inference
Durable image suggestion executor with explicit model test double detects source changes during the model call and fails without applying any description
Evidence-driven repetition checks and conservative suggestions reports exact wording and overlapping source intervals without double-counting repeated shots
Evidence-driven repetition checks and conservative suggestions does not invent reuse for different byte hashes or similar-looking filenames
Evidence-driven repetition checks and conservative suggestions excludes revisions of the current content and preserves missing metrics as unknown
Evidence-driven repetition checks and conservative suggestions requires matching remote identity, mature observations and five samples per hook group on the same channel
SHA catalog revisions and explicit owner acceptance keeps immutable revisions, checks stale writes and exports a pinned manifest without changing source bytes
SHA catalog revisions and explicit owner acceptance rejects tampering, source changes, foreign sources and timed still-image scenes
SHA catalog revisions and explicit owner acceptance rejects a source outside the artifact library even when its path/hash were written into a run
SHA catalog revisions and explicit owner acceptance requires the actual local image-capable provider, deduplicates pending vision jobs and does not accept unreviewed model text
